on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: "The branch, tag or SHA to checkout"
        default: ${{ github.ref }}
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}

      - uses: VKCOM/gh-actions/shared/rust/cargo-cache@main

      - name: Run Test
        run: cargo test --verbose

      - name: Run Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}

      - uses: VKCOM/gh-actions/shared/rust/cargo-cache@main

      - name: Run Build
        run: cargo build-wasip1 --release

name: 'Branch'

run-name: Test ${{ github.ref_name }}

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

concurrency:
  group: test-${{ github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/workflow_test.yml

name: "Cargo update"
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 5 * * 1" # Runs at 05:00, only on Monday

jobs:
  cargo-update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Update swc_core
        uses: VKCOM/gh-actions/shared/rust/cargo-update-toml@main
        with:
          packages: swc_core
      - uses: VKCOM/gh-actions/shared/rust/cargo-update-pr@main
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.DEVTOOLS_GITHUB_TOKEN }}

name: 'Pull Request'

on: ['pull_request']

concurrency:
  group: pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/workflow_test.yml

name: "Publish"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      type:
        description: "version type:"
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: "minor"
        options:
          - patch
          - minor
          - major
      custom_version:
        description: 'custom version: x.y.z (without "v")'
        required: false

run-name: Publish ${{ inputs.type }} ${{ inputs.custom_version }}

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read # Recommended for actions/setup-node
      id-token: write # Required for OIDC
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.DEVTOOLS_GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: ".nvmrc"
          cache: "npm"
          always-auth: true
          registry-url: "https://registry.npmjs.org"

      - name: Install wasm target
        run: |
          rustup target add wasm32-wasip1

      - run: npm run test

      - run: npm run build

      - name: Set Git credentials
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "actions@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"

      - name: Bump by version type
        if: ${{ !github.event.inputs.custom_version }}
        run: npm version ${{ github.event.inputs.type }} --no-commit-hooks -m "v%s"

      - name: Bump by custom version
        if: ${{ github.event.inputs.custom_version }}
        run: npm version ${{ github.event.inputs.custom_version }} --no-commit-hooks -m "v%s"

      - name: Pushing changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@master
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.DEVTOOLS_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}
          tags: true

      - name: Publishing release
        run: npm publish

[package]
name = "swc-plugin-transform-remove-imports"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]

[profile.release]
# This removes more dead code
codegen-units = 1
lto = true

# Optimize for size
opt-level = "s"

# Strip debug symbols
strip = "symbols"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
regex = "1"
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
swc_cached = "2"
swc_core = { version = "77", features = ["ecma_plugin_transform"] }

# .cargo/config defines few alias to build plugin.
# cargo build-wasip1 generates wasm-wasi32 binary
# cargo build-wasm32 generates wasm32-unknown-unknown binary.

{
  "name": "swc-plugin-transform-remove-imports",
  "version": "9.0.0",
  "description": "SWC plugin for remove imports",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "swc-plugin"
  ],
  "homepage": "https://github.com/VKCOM/swc-plugin-transform-remove-imports",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/VKCOM/swc-plugin-transform-remove-imports.git"
  },
  "bugs": "https://github.com/VKCOM/swc-plugin-transform-remove-imports/issues",
  "main": "swc_plugin_transform_remove_imports.wasm",
  "scripts": {
    "prepack": "npm run build",
    "build": "cargo build-wasip1 --release",
    "postbuild": "cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/swc_plugin_transform_remove_imports.wasm .",
    "test": "cargo test",
    "lint": "cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features"
  },
  "files": [
    "swc_plugin_transform_remove_imports.wasm"
  ],
  "preferUnplugged": true
}

import { Button } from 'uiw';
import { Select } from '@uiw/core';

const uiw = require('uiw');
const core = require('@uiw/core');

# These command aliases are not final, may change
[alias]
# Alias to build actual plugin binary for the specified target.
build-wasip1 = "build --target wasm32-wasip1"
build-wasm32 = "build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown"

version: 2
updates:
  # Maintain dependencies for GitHub Actions
  - package-ecosystem: 'github-actions'
    directory: '/'
    schedule:
      interval: 'daily'

  # Maintain dependencies for npm
  - package-ecosystem: 'npm'
    directory: '/'
    schedule:
      interval: 'daily'
    allow:
      - dependency-type: 'direct'

  # Maintain dependencies for Cargo
  - package-ecosystem: 'cargo'
    directory: '/'
    schedule:
      interval: 'weekly'
    allow:
      - dependency-type: 'indirect'
